title: fix(app-shell): an expression field shows the draft's server verdict at its own path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8257mqSrsY5YAmowqeNZ7Vs)_

Fixes #26858

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表达式字段（RLS 的 USING/CHECK、流程边条件）按自己的路径读取草稿 `_diagnostics` 的服务端裁决；该路径有错误时显示服务端消息，不再显示 "Valid CEL"。lint 的边条件 `expression-invalid` 发现补上 `flows[N].edges[M].condition` 路径。
- 为什么改：#26856 之后横幅已显示发布裁决，但字段仍打印自己的客户端结论，两者矛盾（裁定 p2）。
- 风险与回滚：只读路径相等匹配，不复制任何发布规则，不改任何规则的裁决或消息；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/draftVerdict.ts`、`CelPredicateField.tsx`、`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/serverVerdictAtPath-26858.test.tsx` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.edge-condition-path.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：评审通过后合并；无需其他操作。

## What changes

- **lint**: `ExprIssue` gains an optional `path`. A top-level flow edge's `condition` finding carries `flows[N].edges[M].condition` beside its unchanged `where`; `authoring-rules` maps it as `path: i.path ?? i.where`. The served draft verdict therefore lands at `edges.M.condition` (via the existing `itemRelativeIssuePath`). Rule, verdict and message are unchanged; the runtime gate's differential fingerprint compares the same written flow on both sides.
- **app-shell**: `DraftVerdictContext` plus `useServerErrorsAt(path)` in `draftVerdict.ts`, an equality-only lookup on the served path, never a prefix.
  - `CelPredicateField` takes `verdictPath`; when the served verdict has errors at it, the field shows the server message, sets `aria-invalid`, and withholds "Valid CEL". RLS clauses pass `rowLevelSecurity.N.using` / `.check`.
  - `FlowEdgeInspector` shows served errors at `edges.N.condition` under the condition.
  - Providers: `ResourceEditPage` (its served diagnostics), `PermissionMatrixEditPage` (its own draft read, refreshed after each save), and the Studio Automations page (its own flow draft read, refreshed after each save).

## Why

Ruling p2 on #26858: after #26856 the expression field still printed its own client verdict where the draft's server verdict at that path said otherwise (an RLS predicate over a formula field, a flow edge condition). The field now shows the `_diagnostics` verdict at its own path whenever one exists. No publish rule is copied into the client.

## Acceptance notes

Noted by the implementer, not filed (seat-applied body amendment):

- **Class a candidate (read inference only, reach not measured at a public door):** Studio Automations (`AutomationsPillar` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) shows no draft-level publish verdict in its banner or canvas Problems panel. #26856 wired that for the metadata-admin `ResourceEditPage` only; this PR adds only the field-level provider.
- The field-permission `when` CEL field in `PermissionMatrixEditor` gets no `verdictPath`: no served rule was measured at such a path.
- The `lint-flow-patterns` `flow-default-edge-with-condition` finding has no key path, so its served verdict cannot land on an edge field.

## Verification

- New tests: lint 6 (edge path, null member, second flow, map-form no path, start-node no path, runtime gate path); UI 13 across `serverVerdictAtPath-26858`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.serverVerdict-26858`, `ResourceEditPage.serverVerdict-26858`, `AutomationsPillar.serverVerdict-26858`. They cover a refused RLS predicate (server message, no "Valid CEL"), a refused edge condition, the no-verdict control, the sibling-path no-leak case, and the lint finding's `edges.N.condition`.
- Ablations (each restored, blob equal to HEAD): dropping the context read in `CelPredicateField` turns 4 field tests red; in `FlowEdgeInspector`, 3; deleting the lint path assignment, 4; mapping `i.where` only, 1. Controls stay green in each.
- `@objectstack/lint` full suite 7515 passed plus typecheck; `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check; related app-shell suites 1129 passed; after merging `main`, the touched suites 199 passed.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 63 families run, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
